title: on-attack relic ranks

subjects.name: On-attack relic ranks without a side test

problem: About 20 on-attack relic ranks have no side test (matters only when the bearer is Confused)
notes: Hook spec: research/handoff_eval.md 2026-10-26 hook batch B2 built (research/hooks_B2.json, loader/hooks_B2.c). The six 'this relic attacks that target / the enemy' rank gates in bc_OnAttack (L1047, 1051, 1259, 1270, 1274, 1278) are false when attacker and target are on the same side. In-game test: Confuse a bearer of an on-attack follow-up relic (e.g. 'this relic attacks the enemy as well'): when it hits an ally, the relic does not attack that ally; against an enemy it still does.

release_notes.effect: On-attack relic follow-ups ('this relic attacks the target as well')
release_notes.intended: The relic follows up on the bearer's attacks against enemies.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, when a Confused bearer hit an ally, the relic attacked that ally too.
release_notes.fix: Now the follow-up is skipped when the bearer hits its own side.
